messages:
mira_s: Heads-up: CumulusSys + Marketplace joint webinar locked for Jun 12. Need final run-of-show, speaker order, demo fallback plan, and international swag routing.

leah_p: Yay! Can we do a full tech dry run w/ all speakers the week prior? May 30 or Jun 1 afternoons (PDT) work for me.

alex_k: Jun 1 2pm PDT fits my calendar. I'll validate screen-share, slides, and live demo sequence.

pete_r: I'll own swag logistics. Plan: 200 sticker packs, 120 USB-C charger blocks (partner-branded), 50 demo dongle kits. Ship to Cumulus HQ + 3 speaker addresses + 1 regional hub. Prefer DHL for EU.

jordan_m: Cumulus marketing needs our final logo by May 20 for the Marketplace tile. Can someone chase brand?

mira_s: I'll ping brand ops today. Also adding a short rehearsal checklist into the runbook.

ana_cumulus: Ana from Cumulus here 44b. Confirmed on booth pickup and AV contact. Will share local booth Wi-Fi SSID and onsite contact.

ops-bot: Reminder: create #eng-oncall incident channel for webinar day for rapid routing.

leah_p: Draft run-of-show (30m total):
```
17:00 - Host intro (3m)
17:03 - CumulusSys opener (7m)
17:10 - Redwood live demo: marketplace provisioning + quick integration (12m)
17:22 - Live Q&A (8m)
17:30 - Close & CTA (2m)
```

alex_k: For the live demo: show provisioning from Marketplace tile -> auto-provision infra -> demo inference call. If latency > 800ms, fallback to pre-record.

mira_s: Alex, can you create a 2-min pre-recorded clip that mirrors the live actions? Put on s3://redwood-partners/cumulus/jun12/prebake.mp4 and mark version v1.

alex_k: Will do. Also requesting a 2-GPU sandbox on Dedicated for Jun 1 rehearsal (tag partner-rehearsal-jun1).

pete_r: Shipping timeline: ship domestic packages by Jun 2, international by May 29 to meet customs. I'll generate labels and upload manifest.

jordan_m: I'll draft the short post-webinar announcement and share by May 24 for review. Marketing will publish.

leah_p: AV checklist for speakers (to send to Cumulus and presenters):
- confirm HDMI/USB-C adapters
- presenter's mic check at T-45m
- have local backup video + share link

mira_s: Demo fallback steps in runbook:
- T-30m: test demo endpoint, confirm token and model version
- If >800ms latency or errors: switch to prebake.mp4 and play + narrate
- Fallthrough: use canned slides + Q&A

ops-bot: NOTE: add deployment tag partner-rehearsal-jun1 to allowbilling-exemption for sandbox.

alex_k: Adding quick deploy command to runbook:
```
redwoodctl deploy --team=partners --cluster=partner-rehearsal-jun1 --image=marketplace-integration:stable
```

pete_r: Swag manifest done. Labels uploaded to shared drive. Tracking IDs will be posted when carrier picks up.

jordan_m: Cumulus asks for speaker bios and headshots by May 18. I'll collect and share.

mira_s: Actions summary:
- Leah: confirm dry run Jun 1 2pm PDT + distribute AV checklist (due May 18)
- Alex: reserve 2-GPU sandbox + upload prebake clip to S3 (due May 25)
- Pete: finalize swag shipping + upload manifest (labels by May 20)
- Jordan: draft post-webinar announcement + collect bios (due May 18)
- Mira: finalize runbook and open #eng-oncall session for Jun 12

mira_s: If no objections I'll lock the plan by EOD and loop in brand ops + Cumulus. :thumbsup:
